content.short: Sperax is a DeFi protocol on Arbitrum that issues USDs, a fully collateralized and auto-yielding stablecoin.
content.description:
Sperax is a leading decentralized finance protocol built natively on the Arbitrum network, known for its innovative stablecoin, USDs. Unlike traditional assets that require manual staking, USDs is "auto-yielding," meaning holders earn returns automatically in their wallets by simply holding the token. The protocol maintains a 100% collateralization ratio for USDs, investing the underlying assets into a curated selection of low-risk DeFi strategies—such as lending on Aave—to generate the yield distributed to participants.

Governed by the SPA token, the protocol features a robust governance model where stakers receive veSPA to vote on yield strategies and earn a portion of protocol fees. Sperax focuses on professional-grade transparency and on-chain execution, serving as a vital tool for capital preservation and passive income within the Arbitrum ecosystem. Through its commitment to secure and accessible financial innovation, Sperax is building the essential framework for a more efficient and user-friendly decentralized economy, where stablecoins provide real-world utility and returns.
content.meta: Sperax provides the auto-yielding USDs stablecoin and decentralized asset management tools on the Arbitrum network.
